mapper.select: /* PrdSQL.selectPrdDtlInfo */ SELECT A.PRD_CD AS "prdCd", A.PRD_NM AS "prdNm", A.SMPL_DESC AS "smplDesc", A.PRD_STAT_CD AS "prdStatCd", A.L_CAT_CD AS "lCatCd", A.M_CAT_CD AS "mCatCd", A.S_CAT_CD AS "sCatCd", A.STOCK_QTY AS "stockQty", A.DELV_TP_CD AS "delvTpCd", B.SALE_PRC AS "salePrc", B.CARD_DISC_PRC AS "cardDiscPrc", B.CASH_DISC_PRC AS "cashDiscPrc", D1.CAT_NM AS "lCatNm", D2.CAT_NM AS "mCatNm", D3.CAT_NM AS "sCatNm" FROM TB_PRD_MST A LEFT JOIN TB_PRD_PRC B ON A.PRD_CD = B.PRD_CD LEFT JOIN TB_CAT_MNG D1 ON A.L_CAT_CD = D1.CAT_CD LEFT JOIN TB_CAT_MNG D2 ON A.M_CAT_CD = D2.CAT_CD LEFT JOIN TB_CAT_MNG D3 ON A.S_CAT_CD = D3.CAT_CD WHERE A.PRD_CD = #{prdCd}

/* PrdSQL.selectPrdImgList */ SELECT IMG_NO AS "imgNo", PRD_CD AS "prdCd", IMG_PATH AS "imgPath", IMG_TP_CD AS "imgTpCd", SORT_SEQ AS "sortSeq" FROM TB_PRD_IMG WHERE PRD_CD = #{prdCd} ORDER BY IMG_TP_CD, SORT_SEQ
/* PrdSQL.selectCategoryList */ SELECT CAT_CD AS "catCd", CAT_NM AS "catNm" FROM TB_CAT_MNG WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' AND CAT_LVL = 1 ORDER BY SORT_SEQ
/* PrdSQL.selectSubCategoryList */ SELECT CAT_CD AS "catCd", CAT_NM AS "catNm" FROM TB_CAT_MNG WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' AND UP_CAT_CD = #{upCatCd} ORDER BY SORT_SEQ
